symbols.name: standard basis vector
symbols.meaning: The vector of $F^m$ with entry $1$ at coordinate $j$ and $0$ at every other coordinate.
symbols.quote: For each coordinate $j$ with $1\le j\le m$, the standard basis vector $\sigma_j$ is the vector of $F^m$ with entry $1$ at coordinate $j$ and $0$ at every other coordinate.

relations.quote: Each standard basis vector $\sigma_j$ is a basis vector of $F^m$ as defined in [Linear algebra basics](linear-algebra-basics.md).
